header.title: What automation *actually looks like.*
header.subtitle: Typical workflows we automate. See the before — then see what we build.

before.title: Invoice & Payment Collection
steps: Staff manually creates invoice in Excel after every job
Emails PDF to client, waits days for a reply
Chases overdue payments with manual calls
Updates spreadsheet by hand, errors creep in

after.title: Fully Automated Billing System
steps: Invoice auto-generated when job is marked complete
Sent instantly via email + WhatsApp with pay link
Overdue reminders fire automatically on day 3, 7, 14
Dashboard updates in real time — zero manual entry

before.title: Lead Follow-Up Process
steps: Enquiry comes in via website or phone
Staff tries to call back — sometimes hours later
If no answer, lead is often forgotten
No system to track which leads converted

after.title: AI-Powered Lead Engine
steps: AI chatbot responds within seconds, 24/7
Qualifies lead, books a slot, notifies your team
Automated WhatsApp + email sequence nurtures cold leads
CRM logs every interaction, conversion tracked automatically

before.title: Monthly Reporting
steps: Manager spends 4–6 hrs pulling data from multiple tools
Copies numbers into a PowerPoint manually
Report is always a week late, data already stale
Different team members use different formats

after.title: Automated Smart Dashboard
steps: Live dashboard pulls all data automatically every hour
PDF report auto-generated and emailed every Monday 8am
Always fresh, always consistent, zero manual work
Stakeholders have access anytime from any device
